result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and the bottom promotional card is partially clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the Fastest near you row, cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards scroll/resize so full names are visible.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scroll content so cards clear the tab bar.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. Healthy) overflow or are clipped on the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip row is horizontally scrollable with clear overflow and adequate end padding.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under Green Bowl Poké shows '€0.90 delivery' which may be hard to scan next to truncated neighbors.
issues.suggestion: Keep card widths consistent and use ellipsis or wrapping rules so secondary text remains fully readable.
